name: Equivalent Algebraic Trap
description: The exact cover constraint ("each number from 1 to k appears exactly once") is replaced with an algebraically equivalent condition: the sum of 2^x for the k chosen paths must equal 2^{k+1}-2. Mathematically, since the maximum possible value is k and we choose exactly k items, the only way to achieve this exact sum is by picking exactly one of each power from 2^1 to 2^k. Models relying on pattern matching will fail to recognize this equivalence and will implement a subset-sum style backtracking rather than an Exact Cover (DLX) algorithm. Because sum-based pruning is extremely weak when accumulating small values (allowing massive duplication of small coordinates without exceeding the target sum), their search space will explode, guaranteeing a Time Limit Exceeded.
